detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. It is great to have you here to support the Silver Arrows, George Russell, and Kimi Antonelli.
User Query: <event>session start</event>

expectation_details.expectation: The agent provided the qualifying time for the upcoming race converted to Vienna time (CEST / Europe/Vienna) and Edinburgh / UK time (BST / Europe/London) without fabricating session times.
expectation_details.justification: While the agent provided the qualifying time for Vienna (10:00 CEST), it failed to provide the corresponding time for Edinburgh (BST). Furthermore, the initial Agent Text provided before the tool call included a speculative answer that did not rely on the actual tool response, and the tool response itself was used correctly in the final output but the agent did not fulfill the specific requirement to calculate and present the time difference for the user's friend in Edinburgh.
